[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Grennit Mun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who accompanied a group of individuals from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] on a mission to the world [[Byrsym]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
